errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: That file or data type isn't supported.

errors.CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS: This record belongs to a different workspace.

errors.OVER_RECEIPT: More is being received than was ordered. Someone who manages purchasing must confirm it.

errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.

errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link or code has expired or was already used. Please start again.

registration_type.label: GST registration type
registration_type.description: Your GST registration type. Only regular registration is supported now.

prices_include_gst.label: Prices include GST
prices_include_gst.description: Turn on if the prices you enter already include GST.

component_rounding.label: Rounding of tax amounts
component_rounding.description: How each tax amount is rounded to the paisa.

hsn_min_digits.label: Minimum HSN code length
hsn_min_digits.description: Minimum HSN code length required on products.

timing.label: When to create the tax invoice
timing.description: When the tax invoice is created: when goods are dispatched (for the packed quantity), or when the order or backorder is accepted.

round_to_rupee.label: Round invoice totals to the rupee
round_to_rupee.description: Round invoice totals to the nearest rupee with a round-off line.

round_off_method.label: How to round to the rupee
round_off_method.description: How the invoice total is rounded to the rupee.

default_payment_terms_days.label: Default credit days
default_payment_terms_days.description: Default credit days for new retailers (each retailer can differ).

acceptance_mode.label: Order acceptance
acceptance_mode.description: Accept new orders yourself, or automatically when they pass all checks.

send_confirmation_on_accept.label: Send Order Confirmation on acceptance
send_confirmation_on_accept.description: Send the retailer an Order Confirmation (items, prices, tax estimate) when you accept an order.

min_order_value.label: Minimum order value
min_order_value.description: Smallest order value a retailer can place. Backordered items count.

min_order_value_basis.label: Minimum order value includes GST?
min_order_value_basis.description: Whether the minimum order value includes GST.

pre_acceptance_edit_mode.label: Changes before acceptance
pre_acceptance_edit_mode.description: What your team can change before accepting: only reduce or remove items, or also add items and increase quantities. The retailer is always notified.

options.FULL_EDIT: Also add items and increase quantities

staff_can_place_on_behalf.label: Staff can order for retailers
staff_can_place_on_behalf.description: Allow your staff (for example salesmen) to place orders for retailers.

shop_confirms_delivery.label: Shops confirm delivery
shop_confirms_delivery.description: Let shops mark a dispatched shipment as received in their app.

delivery_code.label: Delivery code
delivery_code.description: Give each shipment a 4-digit code at dispatch. The shop gives it to the delivery person, who enters it to mark the shipment delivered.

sales_visibility.label: What sales staff can see
sales_visibility.description: Which orders and retailers sales staff can see.

pending_alert_hours.label: Alert for orders waiting (hours)
pending_alert_hours.description: Show a dashboard alert for orders not accepted within this many hours.

insufficient_stock_action.label: When stock runs short (backorders off)
insufficient_stock_action.description: When backorders are off and stock runs short at checkout: stop the order and show what's short, or place only the in-stock part.

options.FAIL: Stop the order and show what's short

show_exact_quantity.label: Show exact stock to retailers
show_exact_quantity.description: Show retailers the exact quantity in stock (otherwise only "In stock" or "Low stock").

show_low_stock_label.label: Show a "Low stock" label
show_low_stock_label.description: Show a "Low stock" label to retailers when stock is at or below the reorder level.

show_out_of_stock_in_shop.label: Show out-of-stock products to shops
show_out_of_stock_in_shop.description: Shops see products with no stock, marked "Out of stock". Turn off to hide them until stock arrives. Only matters when backorders are off.

cost_method.label: How goods receipts change the cost price
cost_method.description: When you receive goods with a cost, the product's cost price can follow the average of your stock and the new bill, the latest bill, or stay as you set it. You can always change a cost price by hand.

options.WEIGHTED_AVERAGE: Average of stock and new bill

enabled.label: Allow backorders
enabled.description: Let retailers order more than is in stock; the rest is sent when stock arrives.

allocation_mode.label: Allocating arriving stock to backorders
allocation_mode.description: When stock arrives, confirm each backorder allocation yourself, or allocate automatically (oldest orders first).

billing_price.label: Price for backordered items
billing_price.description: Price for backordered items sent later: the price when ordered, or today's price.

breach_action.label: When a credit limit would be exceeded
breach_action.description: When an order would exceed a retailer's credit limit: hold it for approval, or refuse it.

hold_reserves_stock.label: Reserve stock for orders on credit hold
hold_reserves_stock.description: Keep stock reserved for orders waiting for credit approval.

block_overdue_after_days.label: Treat as over limit when overdue by (days)
block_overdue_after_days.description: Treat a retailer as over limit when any invoice is overdue by more than this many days.

hold_advances.label: Keep extra payments as credit
hold_advances.description: Keep extra money paid by a retailer as credit and use it for their next invoices.

cheque_credit_timing.label: When a cheque counts as paid
cheque_credit_timing.description: Credit a cheque to the retailer's account when received (reversed automatically if it bounces) or only when it clears.

sales_can_collect.label: Sales staff can collect payments
sales_can_collect.description: Let sales staff record payments they collect from their shops (tracked until handed over).

cheque_bounce_charge.label: Cheque bounce charge
cheque_bounce_charge.description: Charge a shop this amount when its cheque bounces; ₹0 charges nothing. It is added to the shop's account, due at once, without GST.

ageing_basis.label: Age dues by
ageing_basis.description: Age receivables by days since the invoice date, or by days past the due date.

require_staff_2fa.label: Require two-step verification for staff
require_staff_2fa.description: Require every staff member to set up two-step verification (an authenticator app) before they can sign in.

hsn_rate_hints_enabled.label: Suggest GST rates from HSN codes
hsn_rate_hints_enabled.description: Suggest GST rates from the HSN hint table on product forms and imports.

default_invoice_prefix.label: Default invoice prefix
default_invoice_prefix.description: Prefix proposed when a tenant's first invoice series is created.

impersonation_session_minutes.label: Support session length (minutes)
impersonation_session_minutes.description: Maximum length of a support impersonation session.

login_lockout_threshold.label: Failed sign-ins before locking
login_lockout_threshold.description: Consecutive failed sign-ins before an account is locked.

login_lockout_minutes.label: Lock duration (minutes)
login_lockout_minutes.description: How long a locked account stays locked.

login_rate_per_ip_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempts per IP per minute
login_rate_per_ip_per_minute.description: Sign-in attempts allowed per minute from one IP address (generous: many mobile users share an IP).

login_rate_per_email_per_minute.label: Sign-in attempts per email per minute
login_rate_per_email_per_minute.description: Sign-in attempts allowed per minute for one email address.

otp_rate_per_phone_per_10_minutes.label: Codes per phone per 10 minutes
otp_rate_per_phone_per_10_minutes.description: OTP codes that can be requested for one phone number in 10 minutes.

otp_rate_per_ip_per_hour.label: Codes per IP per hour
otp_rate_per_ip_per_hour.description: OTP codes that can be requested from one IP address per hour (generous: many mobile users share an IP).

password_reset_per_email_per_hour.label: Password reset emails per address per hour
password_reset_per_email_per_hour.description: Password reset emails that can be requested for one email address per hour.

otp_max_verify_attempts.label: Wrong codes allowed
otp_max_verify_attempts.description: Wrong codes allowed before an OTP stops working.

whatsapp_price_utility.label: WhatsApp price: utility
whatsapp_price_utility.description: Price in rupees of one WhatsApp utility message (orders, bills, payments, reminders), used for distributors' cost estimates.

whatsapp_price_marketing.label: WhatsApp price: marketing
whatsapp_price_marketing.description: Price in rupees of one WhatsApp marketing message (announcements).

whatsapp_price_authentication.label: WhatsApp price: authentication
whatsapp_price_authentication.description: Price in rupees of one WhatsApp authentication message (sign-in codes).

einvoice_threshold_crore.label: E-invoicing suggested from (crore)
einvoice_threshold_crore.description: E-invoicing is suggested to businesses with turnover from this many crore rupees. To be verified against the current rules.

irn_limit_threshold_crore.label: IRN reporting-limit warning from (crore)
irn_limit_threshold_crore.description: Businesses with turnover from this many crore rupees are warned when an invoice nears the IRN reporting limit. To be verified.

irn_reporting_days.label: IRN reporting limit (days)
irn_reporting_days.description: Days from the document date within which the IRN must be obtained, for businesses above the reporting-limit threshold. To be verified.

irn_cancel_window_hours.label: IRN cancellation window (hours)
irn_cancel_window_hours.description: Hours after the IRN within which it can be cancelled. To be verified.

ewaybill_cancel_window_hours.label: E-way bill cancellation window (hours)
ewaybill_cancel_window_hours.description: Hours after an e-way bill within which it can be cancelled. To be verified.

report_async_rows.label: Background export limit (rows)
report_async_rows.description: Report exports with more rows than this are made in the background; the person gets a message when the file is ready.

report_link_days.label: Export download days
report_link_days.description: How many days a background export can be downloaded before it is deleted.

b2cl_threshold.label: B2C large threshold (₹)
b2cl_threshold.description: Bills to shops without a GSTIN in another state above this value are listed one by one in the GST summary. To be verified.

ai_monthly_units.label: AI units a month per distributor
ai_monthly_units.description: Most AI units (words and characters, as the provider counts them) a distributor may use in a calendar month. Over it, AI features step aside and the app works without them. 0: no limit.

ai_timeout_seconds.label: Wait for the AI provider (seconds)
ai_timeout_seconds.description: How long the app waits for the AI provider before working without it.

ai_search_min_similarity_percent.label: Closeness for shop search (%)
ai_search_min_similarity_percent.description: How close in meaning a product must be to what a shop typed to be shown after the products that match the words.

ai_assistant_timeout_seconds.label: Wait for the assistant's AI provider (seconds)
ai_assistant_timeout_seconds.description: How long the data assistant waits for the AI provider on each step before giving up on the question.

ai_assistant_model.label: Assistant's model
ai_assistant_model.description: The model the data assistant uses. Check its name and price with the provider before the assistant is switched on.

ai_sonnet_price_in.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5: ₹ per million units in
ai_sonnet_price_in.description: Rupees per million units sent to the model (the question, the instructions and the figures).

ai_sonnet_price_out.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5: ₹ per million units out
ai_sonnet_price_out.description: Rupees per million units the model writes back.

ai_haiku_price_in.label: Claude Haiku 4.5: ₹ per million units in
ai_haiku_price_in.description: Rupees per million units sent to the model.

ai_haiku_price_out.label: Claude Haiku 4.5: ₹ per million units out
ai_haiku_price_out.description: Rupees per million units the model writes back.

ai_embeddings_price.label: Product search: ₹ per million units
ai_embeddings_price.description: Rupees per million units sent to the embedding provider (₹0 when the model runs in our own containers).

ai_question_units_in.label: Typical question: units in
ai_question_units_in.description: Units a typical assistant question sends to the model over all its steps. Used to show the cap and usage as questions and rupees.

ai_question_units_out.label: Typical question: units out
ai_question_units_out.description: Units the model writes back for a typical question.

ai_search_units.label: Typical shop search: units
ai_search_units.description: Units a typical shop search sends to the embedding provider.

languages_enabled.label: Languages for everyone
languages_enabled.description: Language codes everyone may choose, separated by commas, for example “en,hi”. English is always on. Turn a language on only after a native speaker has checked its words.

language_test_tenants.label: Distributors testing languages
language_test_tenants.description: Web addresses (for example “sharma”) of distributors who see every language while it is checked, separated by commas. Super admins always see every language.

blocked_can_sign_in.label: Shops on hold can sign in
blocked_can_sign_in.description: Shops you put on hold can still sign in and see their account, but can't order. Turn off to stop them signing in.

show_own_brand_badge.label: Own-brand badge in the shop
show_own_brand_badge.description: Show an "own brand" badge on your own-brand products in the shop.

default_language.label: Usual language for shops
default_language.description: The language shops see, and get messages and documents in, until they choose their own.

discounts_on_special_prices.label: Discounts on special prices
discounts_on_special_prices.description: Apply discount rules on top of a shop's special prices. Turn off to treat a special price as the final price.

discount_combination.label: When several discounts apply
discount_combination.description: How discounts combine when more than one applies to a product. The total never exceeds the price, and shops see only the total saving.

options.SEQUENTIAL: Apply one after another, most specific first (10% then 5% = 14.5%)

quiet_hours_start.label: Quiet hours start
quiet_hours_start.description: From this time, reminders and other non-urgent WhatsApp, SMS and email messages wait until quiet hours end. In-app messages are never held.

quiet_hours_end.label: Quiet hours end
quiet_hours_end.description: When quiet hours end and held messages go out.

document_link_days.label: Bill links work for (days)
document_link_days.description: How many days a bill or receipt link sent by WhatsApp or email keeps working.

payment_reminder_days.label: Payment reminder days
payment_reminder_days.description: Days to remind shops of their bills, separated by commas: a minus number is days before the due date, the others days after it (e.g. -2,3,7,15,30).

payment_reminder_repeat_days.label: Then remind every (days)
payment_reminder_repeat_days.description: After the last reminder day, remind again every this many days. 0 stops the reminders.

handover_reminder_days.label: Handover reminder after (days)
handover_reminder_days.description: Remind salesmen of collections not handed over after this many days.

daily_summary_enabled.label: Daily summary
daily_summary_enabled.description: Send a summary each morning: yesterday's orders, billing and collections, and what needs action. Who gets it, and how, is set under Who gets which message.

daily_summary_time.label: Daily summary at
daily_summary_time.description: When the daily summary goes out (Indian time).

daily_summary_skip_sunday.label: No daily summary on Sundays
daily_summary_skip_sunday.description: Don't send the daily summary on Sundays.

turnover_band.label: Annual turnover
turnover_band.description: Your business's turnover band. It only decides what we suggest and warn about: e-invoicing is suggested from ₹5 crore, and from ₹10 crore we warn when an invoice is close to the IRN reporting limit.

auto_generate.label: Get IRNs automatically
auto_generate.description: Get the IRN as soon as an invoice or credit note to a shop with a GSTIN is issued. Off: staff get it with the "Get IRN" button.

threshold_inter_state.label: E-way bill above (between states)
threshold_inter_state.description: An e-way bill is made at dispatch when goods go to another state and the invoice (with tax) is worth more than this. ₹50,000 is a placeholder until verified.

threshold_intra_state.label: E-way bill above (within the state)
threshold_intra_state.description: An e-way bill is made when goods stay within your state and the invoice (with tax) is worth more than this. States set their own limit; ₹50,000 is a placeholder until verified.

auto_generate.label: Make e-way bills automatically
auto_generate.description: Make the e-way bill at dispatch when the invoice needs one. Off: staff make it with the "Make e-way bill" button.

movement_days.label: Fast, slow and dead stock period (days)
movement_days.description: How far back to look when sorting products into fast, slow and dead stock.

fast_share_percent.label: Fast-moving share (%)
fast_share_percent.description: The share of products that sold, counted from the top, that is called fast-moving.

demand_days.label: Demand period (days)
demand_days.description: Daily demand is what shops ordered over this many days.

safety_days.label: Safety stock (days)
safety_days.description: Extra stock, in days of demand, kept for late deliveries and busy weeks.

cover_days.label: Order to cover (days)
cover_days.description: A suggested order covers this many days of demand after it arrives.

default_lead_days.label: Usual delivery time (days)
default_lead_days.description: Days from ordering to receiving, when the supplier's own time isn't set.

abc_a_percent.label: Class A share (%)
abc_a_percent.description: Class A: your top products that together make this share of sales value.

abc_b_percent.label: Class B share (%)
abc_b_percent.description: Class B: the next products, up to this share of sales value. The rest are class C.

over_receipt_tolerance_percent.label: Receiving more than ordered (%)
over_receipt_tolerance_percent.description: Up to this share over the order is accepted. Beyond it, someone who manages purchasing must confirm.

new_days.label: A shop is new for (days)
new_days.description: A shop counts as new for this many days after its first order.

dormant_days.label: Stopped ordering after (days)
dormant_days.description: A shop that hasn't ordered for this many days has stopped ordering.

slowing_percent.label: Slowing down at (% of its usual gap)
slowing_percent.description: A shop is slowing down when it hasn't ordered for this share of its usual gap between orders (150% of 10 days: 15 days).

contact_snooze_days.label: After a contact, leave the list for (days)
contact_snooze_days.description: After someone contacts a shop, it leaves the win-back list for this many days.

shop_requests.label: Shops ask for returns in the app
shop_requests.description: Let shops ask for returns from their app. You approve each one, which issues the credit note.

request_days.label: Days to ask for a return
request_days.description: How many days after a bill a shop can ask to return goods from it.

language.label: Language on shop documents
language.description: Bills, credit notes, receipts, refund vouchers and Order Confirmations show their labels in English and the shop's language, or in English only. Names and amounts are printed as entered either way.

nav.label: Purchasing sections
nav.offBody: Ask the platform team to switch on purchasing for your business.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: The firms you buy from: contacts, delivery days and what each supplies.
suppliers.name: Supplier
suppliers.emptyBody: Add the firms you buy from, import them from Excel, or make them from the names on your past goods receipts.
suppliers.noMatchBody: Try another name or clear the filters.

supplierForm.newDescription: Purchase orders are emailed to the supplier's address.
supplierForm.name: Name
supplierForm.gstinHint: Leave empty for an unregistered supplier. The state comes from it.
supplierForm.stateHint: Needed when there's no GSTIN, for the GST estimate.
supplierForm.leadTimeHint: Days from ordering to receiving. Empty: your usual delivery time.
supplierForm.activeHint: Inactive suppliers can't get new purchase orders.
supplierForm.deleteBody: It goes from the lists and from every product it supplied. Past goods receipts and purchase orders keep it.

supplierProducts.title: What they supply
supplierProducts.emptyBody: Link products on a product's page, or select products in the list and choose “Set preferred supplier”.

productSuppliers.title: Suppliers
productSuppliers.editTitle: Who this product is bought from
productSuppliers.editBody: The preferred supplier is used for reorder suggestions and new purchase orders.
productSuppliers.firstPreferred: The first supplier will be the preferred one.

fromReceipts.title: Suppliers from past goods receipts
fromReceipts.description: The supplier names typed on your past goods receipts. Choose what each one is, and the receipts are linked to it.
fromReceipts.receipts: {count, plural, one {# goods receipt} other {# goods receipts}}
fromReceipts.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing chosen} one {Confirm # name} other {Confirm # names}}
fromReceipts.done: {created, plural, =0 {} one {# supplier added, } other {# suppliers added, }}{linked, plural, one {# receipt linked} other {# receipts linked}}
fromReceipts.emptyBody: Every goods receipt with a supplier name is linked to a supplier.

orders.title: Purchase orders
orders.description: What you ordered from suppliers, what has arrived and what is late.
orders.emptyBody: Create one here, or from the reorder suggestions.
orders.noMatchBody: Try another number or clear the filters.

editor.newBody: Choose the supplier and add products. It is saved as a draft until you send it.
editor.sentNote: This order was sent: after saving, send it again so the supplier gets the revised copy.
editor.expectedHint: Empty: today plus the supplier's delivery days.
editor.emptyLines: Scan or search for the products to order.
editor.noCostNote: Costs come from the supplier's last price, or the product's cost price.
editor.costFor: Cost of one {unit} of {name}, before GST
editor.created: Purchase order saved as a draft

order.taxNote: The supplier's invoice has the actual tax; this estimate is for information.
order.pdfPreparing: The PDF is being prepared. Try again in a moment.
order.sendBodyEmail: It is emailed to {email}, and you get a link to share on WhatsApp.
order.sendBody: You get a link to the order to share with the supplier (WhatsApp or another way).
order.emailed: Sent, and emailed to the supplier
order.sentNoEmail: Sent. The supplier has no email: share the link.
order.emailedShare: Emailed to the supplier. You can also share the link:
order.noEmailShare: The supplier has no email address. Share the link with them:
order.cancelBodySent: Nothing more will be received against it. Say why.
order.cancelBodyDraft: The draft is kept as cancelled.
order.emailSupplier: Email the supplier that it's cancelled (untick if you've told them)
order.cancelledEmailed: Purchase order cancelled, and the supplier emailed
order.closeBody: What hasn't arrived won't come: it is cancelled, and the order is closed.

stats.title: Stock planning
stats.notYet: Not worked out yet: they're worked out every night.

why.demand: Shops ordered {demand} {unit} in the last {days} days ({rate}).
why.lowHistory: Little sales history, so this goes by the reorder level and any shops waiting.
why.position: {available} {unit} available{hasWaiting, select, true {, {waiting} waiting for shops} other {}}{hasOnOrder, select, true {, {onOrder} on order} other {}}.
why.point: Reorder at {point} {unit}: {lead} days to arrive ({source}) plus {safety} days of safety stock.
why.cover: This order covers {cover} days after it arrives{hasWaiting, select, true { and the {waiting} {unit} shops are waiting for} other {}}.
why.upToLevel: It brings stock up to the reorder level of {level} {unit}{hasWaiting, select, true {, plus the {waiting} {unit} shops are waiting for} other {}}.

lead.PRODUCT_SUPPLIER: the supplier's time for this product

why.noRecentOrders: No shop ordered this in the last {days} days, so this goes by the reorder level and any shops waiting.
why.waitingOnly: It covers the {waiting} {unit} shops are waiting for.

suggestions.title: Reorder suggestions
suggestions.description: What to order before it runs out, worked out every night from what shops order.
suggestions.offBody: Ask the platform team to switch on stock planning for your business.
suggestions.dismissBody: It won't be suggested again until the date you choose (a week if you leave it empty).
suggestions.refreshing: Working out the figures again. They'll be here in a minute.
suggestions.refreshTooSoon: They're already being worked out. Try again in a few minutes.
suggestions.selectPage: Select all suggestions on this page
suggestions.ordersCreated: {count, plural, one {Draft purchase order {numbers} created} other {# draft purchase orders created: {numbers}}}
suggestions.levelsApplied: {count, plural, =0 {The reorder levels were already set} one {Reorder level set for # product} other {Reorder levels set for # products}}
suggestions.emptyBody: Every product has enough stock for now.
suggestions.noMatchBody: Try another product or clear the filters.
suggestions.apartEmptyBody: No product is below its reorder level without selling.

rate.about: about {qty} {unit} {period, select, DAY {a day} WEEK {a week} other {a month}}

notSelling.note: Below its reorder level but not selling. Consider lowering the reorder level.

headline.orderPacks: Order {qty} {unit} ({packs, plural, one {# pack} other {# packs}} of {pack})
headline.lessThanDay: less than a day of stock left
headline.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {about # day} other {about # days}} of stock left

list.title: Shop activity
list.description: Who stopped ordering, who orders less than usual and who never ordered, most urgent first. Worked out every night.
list.refreshing: Working it out. The list updates in a moment.
list.daysAgo: {days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}
list.message: Namaste {name}, this is {staff} from {business}. We haven't had an order from {shop} for a while. Is there anything we can help with? You can order on our app any time.
list.emptyWinBackBody: Every shop is ordering as usual, or someone contacted it lately.
list.emptyBody: Add shops to see how often they order.

contact.title: Log a contact with {shop}
contact.body: The shop leaves the win-back list for a while after a contact.
contact.noteHint: Optional, for example when they will order.
contact.saved: Saved. {shop} leaves the win-back list for a while.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.body: Ask about your sales, shops, stock and dues. Answers come from your reports: only your business's figures, and only those you may see.
assistant.label: Your question
assistant.placeholder: For example: Which shops haven't ordered in 30 days?

suggestions.notOrdering: Which shops haven't ordered in 30 days?
suggestions.topProducts: What are our top 10 products this month?
suggestions.salesMonth: How much did we sell this month?
suggestions.dues: Who owes us the most money?
suggestions.collections: How much did we collect this week?
suggestions.backorders: What are shops waiting for on backorder?

assistant.noQuestionsBody: Ask one above, or tap a suggestion.
assistant.failed: I couldn't answer that just now. Try again in a minute.
assistant.limited: This month's AI allowance is used up. The assistant will be back next month.
assistant.showing: Showing {shown} of {count}. Open the report for all of them.
assistant.nothingBody: The assistant answers from reports, and your role has none of them. Ask the owner if you need it.
